concern: (low) Touch target area for header navigation items should explicitly guarantee 44x44px minimum bounding box across mobile touch viewports per Fitts's Law.
jtbd: When navigating the interface on a mobile touch screen, I want header navigation items to provide a minimum touch bounding box of 44x44px, so that I can accurately trigger intended links without miss-taps or unintended navigation errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a mobile viewport (width <= 640px), When inspecting interactive header navigation elements in the DOM, Then each navigation anchor element has a computed interactive bounding box of at least 44x44 CSS pixels without overlapping neighboring items or disrupting visual flow.
editInstruction: In design/approved/20261118031025-mockup/mockup.html, inspect the <nav role="navigation"> links and modify their styling so that on touch viewports (or universally) each anchor link guarantees a minimum interactive target size of 44x44px (e.g., change class from 'rounded-sm p-1' to 'inline-flex items-center justify-center min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] px-3 py-2 rounded-md') while preserving layout alignment and existing focus ring indicators.

concern: (low) Form inputs should specify visual presentation for loading and error validation feedback states.
jtbd: When filling and submitting control parameters, I want explicit visual cues indicating active loading and field-level validation errors, so that I can immediately detect and correct submission problems without ambiguous system states.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the parameters control form, When an input fails validation or an asynchronous submission is in progress, Then the input reflects distinct visual states: error state applies a contrasting red border/focus ring with associated descriptive error message and aria-invalid="true", and loading state presents a visible spinner or reduced opacity state with aria-busy="true".
